2. STATUTORY & OPERATIONAL CROSSWALK
This crosswalk maps every section of the Proposed 2026 Bylaws directly to its implementing Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) file.
```{r crosswalk}
# Construct crosswalk dataframe
crosswalk_data <- data.frame(
  Bylaw_Article = c(
    "Article I (§ 1.01–1.03)", 
    "Article II (§ 2.01–2.04)", 
    "Article III (§ 3.01–3.05)", 
    "Article IV (§ 4.01–4.08)", 
    "Article IV (§ 4.06a)", 
    "Article IV (§ 4.06b)", 
    "Article V (§ 5.05)", 
    "Article VI (§ 6.01–6.02)", 
    "Article VI (§ 6.03)", 
    "Article VII (§ 7.01–7.05)", 
    "Article VIII (§ 8.01–8.02)", 
    "Article IX (§ 9.01–9.03)", 
    "Article IX (§ 9.05–9.06)", 
    "Article IX (§ 9.06)"
  ),
  Subject_Area = c(
    "Objectives & Board Advisory Role",
    "Membership Standards & Ethics",
    "Officer Duties & Meeting Minutes",
    "Sub-Committee Structure & Charters",
    "Pest Conditions Reporting",
    "Conference Planning & CEUs",
    "Electronic Meetings & Written Consent",
    "Voting Eligibility & Secret Ballots",
    "Master Roster Management",
    "Annual Meeting & Field Safety",
    "Public Outreach & Support Letters",
    "Financial Thresholds & Contracting",

  ),
  Implementing_SOP = c(
    "SOP-010 (Outreach)",
    "SOP-001 (Code of Ethics)",
    "SOP-005 (Agendas/Minutes)",
    "SOP-002 (Charter Template)",
    "SOP-003 (Conditions Report)",
    "SOP-012 (CEU Accreditation)",
    "SOP-006 (Electronic Voting)",
    "SOP-006 (Confidential Voting)",
    "SOP-008 (Membership Roster)",
    "SOP-007 (Field Safety)",
    "SOP-010 (Public Outreach)",
    "SOP-004 (Financial Thresholds)",
    "SOP-009 (Recordkeeping & Audits)",
    "SOP-011 (Travel Policy)"
  ),
  File_Path = c(
    "Draft-SOP-009-Outreach.md",
    "Draft-SOP-001-Proposed_Code_of_Ethics.md",
    "Draft-SOP-005-Committee-Meeting-Agendas.md",
    "Draft-SOP-002-Sub-Committee-Charter-Template.md",
    "Draft-SOP-003-Conditions-Report-Guidelines.md",
    "Draft-SOP-011-CEUs.md",

    "Draft-SOP-004-Financial-Thresholds.md",
    "Draft-SOP-008-Recordkeeping-Audits.md",
    "Draft-SOP-010-Travel.md"
  )
)

knitr::kable(crosswalk_data, col.names = c("Bylaws Provision", "Operational Focus", "Implementing SOP", "File Reference"))
```

3. INTERACTIVE TEXT COMPARISON (DIFF ANALYSIS)
The interactive widget below directly compares the historical 1951 Legacy Bylaws against the updated 2026 Proposed Governance Framework to highlight modernizations in committee structure, financial controls, and voting protections.

```{r comparison-widget}
# Render side-by-side interactive text diff
diffr(
  before = "Current-Bylaws-Archived/1951-CFPC-Bylaws.md", 
  after = "Proposed-2026-Bylaws/Article-4-Committees.md", 
  beforeTitle = "1951 Legacy Bylaws", 
  afterTitle = "2026 Proposed Revision (Article IV)"
)
```
